# Cyberia

> cyberstate led by superintelligence. A cyberstate is a shared mind uniting space, capital and knowledge. We build the one where humans, machines, animals and all life flourish together — on the way to the stars.

Cyberia is a network state: a protocol for superintelligence (cyber), a personal robot that interfaces it (cyb), a software stack (soft3) and physical cities, the first being Cyber Valley, 37 ha on Sanghyang volcano in Bali, started 2021. Everything is open: source, graph and weights. The license is six words: don't trust, don't fear, don't beg.

## doors

- [cyberstates.net](https://cyberstates.net): every state ranked by freedom and openness: the sovereignty terminal
- [cyberia.capital](https://cyberia.capital): the capital of cyberia in ethereum: citizenship and the century index
- [cyber.page](https://cyber.page): the protocol for superintelligence: get paid to understand
- [cyb.ai](https://cyb.ai): the immortal robot: your interface to superintelligence
- [soft3.org](https://soft3.org): the stack: ten rungs from the virtual machine to the state
- [cybervalley.io](https://cybervalley.io): the genesis city: 37 ha on Sanghyang, Bali
- [cyberia.blog](https://cyberia.blog): the chronicle and the published graph
- [github.com](https://github.com/cyberia-to): the source: every repository in the open
- [x.com](https://x.com/cyberiacap): the voice: @cyberiacap

## canon

- [the litepaper](https://cyber.page/litepaper): the whole argument of cyber in ten minutes
- [the whitepaper](https://cyber.page/whitepaper): the mechanisms, the mathematics, the proofs
- [the stack, soft3.org/layers](https://soft3.org/layers): ten rungs — nox, trident, joy, cybergraph, neural, cy, soft3, cyb, cyber, cyberia
- [the chronicle, cyberia.blog](https://cyberia.blog): one beat a day and the published knowledge graph
- [the organization on GitHub](https://github.com/cyberia-to): the registry of every repository is in the README of the `.github` repository

## symbols

- the flag: seven circles in a heptagon, the visible spectrum bent into a loop — https://cyberia.to/img/flag.svg
- the name: cyber•ia — cyber, the superintelligence, and ia, the land it stands on
- the anthem: Cyberia Calling, 3:23, by st_joy, 2026 — https://cyberia.to/cyberia.calling.mp3; the set, Atlas Shrugged, 27:09 — https://cyberia.to/atlas.shrugged.set.mp3

## for agents

- this page: https://cyberia.to/ — static, one HTML file, JSON-LD for Organization, WebSite and MusicRecording in the head
- machine-readable: https://cyberia.to/llms.txt (this file), https://cyberia.to/sitemap.xml, https://cyberia.to/robots.txt
- the player is embeddable on any site with one line: <script src="https://cyberia.to/player.js" async></script>
- founders: mastercyb (https://x.com/mastercyb) and joy (https://x.com/st_joy)
